description: Context passed to DataCellTemplate. Contains the aggregated cell value and its position in the pivot matrix.

members.name: ColumnFieldValues
members.description: Display values of the column dimension keys for this cell.

members.name: ColumnIndex
members.description: Zero-based column index of the leaf column.

members.name: FormattedValue
members.description: The formatted string representation of the value.

members.name: IsNull
members.description: Whether the cell has no data.

members.name: RowFieldValues
members.description: Display values of the row dimension keys for this cell.

members.name: RowIndex
members.description: Zero-based row index of the leaf row.

members.name: Value
members.description: The raw aggregated value (may be null).

members.name: ValueFieldIndex
members.description: The zero-based index of the value field (measure) within the leaf column.
